name: 💪Ninja Warrior Rewind
desc:
🏋️ Welcome to Ninja Warrior Rewind, Roblox’s toughest obstacle course! Get ready for an epic, adrenaline-fueled adventure inspired by American Ninja Warrior and Sasuke—with a twist! 

🌟 Packed with four tricky and challenging courses that will push your skills to the limit. 

🚀 Are you ready to take on the challenge of becoming a true Ninja Warrior? 🏆 

💥 Double XP every weekend! 💥

- Chat tag
